title: Categories
subtitle: Group items so they're easier to find and to discount together. Open a category to see or add what's inside it.
insideSummary: {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in total, {subcategories, plural, =0 {no sub-categories} one {# sub-category} other {# sub-categories}}.
empty: No categories yet. Add one above.
emptyInside: {name} is empty: no sub-categories and no items yet. Add a sub-category above, or file items under it from Items & SKUs.
duplicate: A category with that name already exists. Names are unique across all categories.

sort.title: {count, plural, one {# item needs} other {# items need}} sorting
sort.explanation: These are filed straight under {name}. Now that it has sub-categories, move each one into the sub-category it belongs in. Until then they still show up under {name}.
sort.move: Move {count, plural, =0 {items} one {# item} other {# items}}
sort.moved: Moved {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to {name}.

rename.title: Rename “{name}”
rename.description: The new name shows everywhere this category is used. Names are unique across all categories.
rename.label: Name

move.title: Move “{name}”
move.description: Everything inside it moves along with it. It can't go inside itself or one of its own sub-categories.
move.label: Move it into
move.displaces: {name} has {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} of its own, which will then need sorting into its sub-categories.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.description: It has no sub-categories and no items, so nothing else changes. This can't be undone.
delete.hasSubcategories: It has {count, plural, one {# sub-category} other {# sub-categories}}. Delete or move those first.
delete.hasItems: It still has {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}. Move them to another category first (Items & SKUs, select them, Move to category).
